parsed_json.up: Define the compound set by starting from CHEMBL1422 in molecule_dictionary, then include the parent and all salts via molecule_hierarchy (parent_molregno mapping). Retrieve activity provenance through the FAQ path: molecule_dictionary -> compound_records -> docs -> activities -> assays -> target_dictionary. LEFT JOIN compound_structures for canonical_smiles. Filter to activities where standard_type is IC50, standard_units is nM, and target chembl_id is CHEMBL284. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Sort by all returned columns. No row limit.
